name: ai-video-generation-benchmarks
description: A collection of human-provided prompts, outputs, and evaluation data intended to benchmark AI video generation models on fidelity, temporal coherence, and alignment to text prompts. It focuses on perceptual quality and semantic faithfulness of generated videos across diverse scenarios. Evaluation typically emphasizes human judgments and aggregate quality ratings.
reputation: A small, community-contributed benchmark used for early comparisons of video generation models; not yet widely standardized.
